name: jq
description: Original JSON stream processor with functional programming constructs - the standard for JSON querying and transformation

jq.description: The original and most comprehensive JSON processor with powerful functional programming constructs - industry standard for complex JSON transformations and queries
jq.usage:
curl api.com/data | jq '.results[] | select(.score > 80)' # Filter API responses
cat logs.json | jq -s 'group_by(.level) | map({level: .[0].level, count: length})' # Aggregate log levels
echo '{}' | jq '.timestamp = now | .uuid = \"3caab4e9-9d9d-4b82-8801-558a77004590\"' # Generate enriched JSON
jq -r '.users[] | [.name, .email] | @csv' data.json # Convert to CSV
